def VTask.map {α β : Type} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
  let E' := f '' M.E
  let Indep (s : Set β) := ∃ t, M.Indep t ∧ s = f '' t
  let hI0 : Indep ∅ :=
    ⟨∅, M.indep_empty, by simp⟩
  let hI1 : ∀ {s t}, s ⊆ t → Indep t → Indep s :=
    fun s t hst hIndep =>
      let ⟨t', hIndep_t', rfl⟩ := hIndep
      let s' := {x | x ∈ t' ∧ f x ∈ s}
      have h_s'_subset_t' : s' ⊆ t' := by
        intro x hx
        exact hx.1
      have h_s_image : f '' s' = s :=
        let h_subset := Set.image_subset _ hst
        Set.image_preimage_eq_of_inj_on hf h_subset
      ⟨s', M.indep_subset hIndep_t' h_s'_subset_t', h_s_image⟩
  let hI2 : ∀ {s t}, Indep s → Indep t → s.card > t.card → ∃ e, e ∈ s ∧ e ∉ t ∧ Indep (t ∪ {e}) :=
    fun hIndep_s hIndep_t h_card_gt =>
      let ⟨s', hIndep_s', rfl⟩ := hIndep_s
      let ⟨t', hIndep_t', rfl⟩ := hIndep_t
      let ⟨e, he_s', h_add⟩ := M.indep_augment hIndep_s' hIndep_t' h_card_gt
      have e_not_in_t' : e ∉ t' :=
        by
        intro h
        have hfe_in_t := by simp [h]
        have hfe_in_s := by simp [he_s']
        have hfe_in_t' := hf.injective hfe_in_t
        have hfe_in_s' := hf.injective hfe_in_s
        exact absurd hfe_in_t' hfe_in_s'
      let f_e := f e
      ⟨f_e, by
        simp [he_s'],
        fun h =>
          match h with
          | Or.inl _ => absurd h e_not_in_t'
          | Or.inr h => by
            have hfe_in_t := by simp [h]
            exact hf.injective hfe_in_t e_not_in_t',
        by
        simp [Indep, hIndep_t, e_not_in_t', h_add]⟩
  let axioms := ⟨hI0, hI1, hI2⟩
  Matroid.mk E' Indep axioms
